title: Simple Frontend

Simple Frontend is a test panel used by the plugin-ci-workflows test suite to check that catalog docs are validated, built and packaged.

![Simple Frontend panel](./img/panel.png)

- [Options](./options.md) lists every panel option.
- [Data formats](./data-formats.md) describes the data the panel accepts.
